# TechPicksIO

> Spec-first buying guides for mobile filmmaking gear: rigs, mics, lighting,
> gimbals, drones and storage for iPhone and Android creators. Recommendations
> are built from published specs, measured weights and hands-on testing —
> not marketing copy. We are an Amazon Associate and earn from qualifying
> purchases (full disclosure: /disclosure).

- [Rode Wireless Micro vs. DJI Mic Mini](/rode-vs-dji-mic/): head-to-head spec
  and audio-quality comparison
- [5 Best Wireless Lavalier Mics Under $100](/best-lav-mics-under-100/)
